newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA aims to maintain div payout ratio.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA aims to maintain div payout ratio.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said on Tuesday that it planned to maintain its dividend payout ratio to earnings per share of 80 percent in the year to June 30, 1997.

"As far as future dividends are concerned, it is directors present intention to maintain the ratio of dividends per share to earnings per share at around 80 percent June 1996-97," chairman Tim Besley told shareholders at the annual meeting.
"Maintaining the payout ratio is, of course, subject to there being no significant changes to the bank's business activities," Besley said.
The bank, of the the four major private banks in Australia, paid total dividends of 90 cents per share in 1995/96 and 80 cents a year earlier.
